intro: Harbin rewards visitors with winter ice art, European architecture, and a lively food scene. Pick how long you have and what you enjoy most.
tour_note: Check the tour page for which entry tickets are included.

notes: Buses cover most of the city; fares are ¥1-2, pay by IC card or cash.
Taxis are cheap; ask for the meter (请打表) and expect a ¥1 fuel surcharge.
Ride apps like Didi work in Harbin; taxis often stop for extra passengers at peak.
Driving is not advised for short visits; traffic is dense and signage is mostly Chinese.
Summer ferries cross the Songhua River to Sun Island; tickets sold at the dock.

sophia.name: Saint Sophia Cathedral
sophia.tip: Come early morning for photos without crowds. The green onion domes look best against a blue sky.

icefestival.name: Harbin Ice and Snow Festival
icefestival.price_text: ≈ CNY 300–400 per park (check on the day)
icefestival.hours: Runs roughly late Dec to late Feb · Ice park open into the evening
icefestival.tip: Go after dark when the ice is lit. Wear the warmest layers you own; it can be below -20°C.

songhua.name: Songhua River
songhua.tip: In deep winter the river freezes and locals walk across. Stay near marked paths and follow the crowds.

polarland.name: Harbin Polarland
polarland.tip: Good indoor break from the cold. Check the penguin and beluga show times at the gate.

volga.name: Volga Manor
volga.tip: It is far from the centre, so allow half a day and check transport back before you go.

zhongyang.name: Zhongyang Dajie (Central Street)
zhongyang.tip: Walk the full cobbled street and look up at the old European facades. Buy a hot drink to keep hands warm.

hongzhuan.name: Hongzhuan Street food market
hongzhuan.tip: Try local sausages and hot bread. Point at what looks busy; cash and phone pay both work.

sophia_square.name: Sophia Square viewpoint
sophia_square.tip: The open square gives the best full view of the cathedral. Good spot for a group photo.

sun_island.name: Sun Island Park
sun_island.price_text: ≈ CNY 30 in summer; snow sculpture park extra in winter
sun_island.tip: Big park for a slow walk. In winter the snow sculpture area is a separate ticket.

daowai_walk.name: Daowai old neighbourhood walk
daowai_walk.tip: Older streets and small shops away from the tourist core. Go with daylight and keep it simple.

ice_activity.name: Frozen-river ice activities
ice_activity.price_text: ≈ CNY 30–80 per ride or slide (check on the day)
ice_activity.tip: Sledding and ice slides appear on the river in deep winter. Pay per activity and agree the price first.

sophia_night.name: Central Street evening stroll
sophia_night.tip: The street is lit and lively after dark. Dress in layers; the wind makes it feel much colder.

russian_food.name: Russian-style restaurant meal
russian_food.tip: Harbin has a long Russian food tradition. Book ahead on winter weekends.

stalin_park.name: Stalin Park riverside
stalin_park.tip: Riverside park good for a quiet walk. In winter it is a starting point for the frozen river.

railway_station_area.name: Harbin Railway Station area
railway_station_area.tip: Useful for arrivals and departures. Keep bags close in the busy station square.

snow_sculpture.name: Sun Island Snow Sculpture Art Expo
snow_sculpture.tip: Huge snow sculptures, best seen in daylight. Separate ticket from the ice park.

local_market.name: Local morning food street
local_market.tip: Go early for hot breakfast snacks with locals. Bring small cash just in case.

museum.name: Heilongjiang Provincial Museum
museum.tip: Warm indoor stop with regional history. Check opening days before you go.

guided_tour.name: Half-day city walking tour
guided_tour.price_text: ≈ CNY 150–300 per person (check on the day)
guided_tour.tip: A guide helps with language and winter logistics. Confirm meeting point and language in advance.

songhua_cruise.name: Songhua River boat ride
songhua_cruise.price_text: ≈ CNY 40–80 (summer only, check on the day)
songhua_cruise.tip: Short river crossing in warm months. Not running when the river is frozen.

stays.why: Walk to the pedestrian street, St Sophia Cathedral and riverside. Easiest base for first-timers.
Cheap, handy for trains and the metro; a short taxi to the old town sights.
Older streets, local food and markets; good value and a real neighbourhood feel.
Close to Sun Island and the Ice and Snow World site; quieter, but you need taxis or the metro to the centre.

food: Try Harbin red sausage (红肠) and Russian-style bread from old bakeries near Zhongyang Dajie.
Hotpot and barbecue are winter staples; expect ¥60–150 per person.
Guobaorou (sweet-and-sour pork) is a local classic; look for busy family restaurants in Daowai.
Winter street snacks: frozen pears, candied hawthorn skewers and roasted sweet potatoes, ¥5–20.
Ice cream and cold noodles are popular even in winter; check hygiene at small street stalls.
more_time: Add a day trip to the Siberian Tiger Park north of the river; check opening hours on the day.
In summer, take the Songhua River ferry to Sun Island for parks and walks.
Swap one city day for the Russian-influenced architecture around St Sophia and the old Jewish quarter.
